purpose: Materialize and qualify a content-addressed single-GPU Skill-Pro runtime before any P1 outcome-bearing episode or evolution generation.

adaptations.justification: Pinned README troubleshooting explicitly instructs users to set tensor_parallel_size to 1 on a single-GPU machine.

adaptations.change: add swap_space=0 to vLLM LLM constructor
adaptations.justification: The first model-load smoke failed during vLLM CPU KV swap-cache allocation. Host diagnostics showed 1 GiB pinned allocation succeeds while 2 GiB fails with the same CUDA invalid-argument error; vLLM 0.6.3.post1 defaults to 4 GiB CPU swap per GPU. Setting swap_space=0 eliminates only the unused CPU swap cache; the selected model still loaded with 47,413 GPU KV blocks on the 80GB A100.

semantic_runtime_invariants: vLLM sampling defaults from released LocalLLM unchanged: temperature=0.6, top_p=0.9, max_tokens=1024
no P1 task outcome observed before these adaptations and model selection were frozen

model_freeze.selection_timing: Frozen after zero-outcome runtime import/environment qualification and before any P1 episode outcome.
model_freeze.selection_rule: Use an already-local, no-download, instruction-tuned approximately-7B model that fits one A100; do not choose a model after observing P1 outcome.
model_freeze.role: carrier compatibility model; not claimed as the original Skill-Pro paper backbone
